notes: Route: robots.txt (200, permissive for /sitemap/) advertises sitemap-index/398-ee_google_sitemap.xml, a QUARTERLY chunk index (398-YYYY-Q-0001.xml); /sitemap.xml, /feed, /sitemap_index.xml all 404. Fetched the two chunks covering the window: 398-2026-3-0001.xml (200, 5331 urls, items published 07-01..09-30) and 398-2026-4-0001.xml (200, 761 urls, items published 10-01..10-25). Key gotcha: <lastmod> is the EDIT time, not publication (Q3 chunk lastmod ranges to 2026-10-22 because old items get re-edited), so the script uses <news:publication_date> present on every item and takes the calendar date exactly as the site writes it, no tz conversion. 942 unique URLs, all 31 days covered (min day 21; check days 09-30=36, 10-10=30, 10-20=36), ~10s runtime, 2 sitemap requests. Verified 4 random articles (one per check day + 10-25): all 200, 8.2k-9.7k visible chars, page JSON-LD datePublished exactly equals the listed date. No Wayback needed; news sitemap 410-* only holds ~5 days so it was not used.
